title: EV Charging Prediction Result
description: Published to evdt/v1/results/charging by Laptop 2 ML worker. Contains duration/energy predictions correlated by requestId.

messageId.description: Unique per MQTT message for QoS 1 deduplication.

processedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when inference completed.

durationHours.description: Predicted charging duration (hours). ML estimate, not measured.

energyKwh.description: Predicted energy consumed (kWh). ML estimate, not measured.

warnings.description: Human-readable caveats (e.g., input near training bounds).

error.description: Present when status = error or invalid_request.

message.description: Safe message — no stack traces or secrets.
